headline: Red Star's 5-1 home form meets Copenhagen's 3-0 European start
summary: FK Crvena Zvezda warmed up for Copenhagen with a 5-1 home win on Sunday, and 6.02 expected goals against 0.52 says the scoring form is real. Their Conference League opener went the other way: a 3-2 defeat at Lugano, a late penalty deciding it. Copenhagen beat Braga 3-0 on matchday one, but drew 1-1 at home with Aarhus on Sunday. Novosti reports Ivanić and Katić return to the squad. Across the market, margin removed, Red Star are narrow favourites at 42%, and Over 2.75 is at 50.9%.
read: Crvena Zvezda host Copenhagen needing a first Conference League point after losing 3-2 at Lugano, against visitors who opened with a 3-0 win over Braga. The market still makes the Serbs narrow home favourites at 42.0% on a quarter-goal handicap, with the goal line at 2.75 splitting the two teams on the night.

facts.fact: Crvena Zvezda are the home favourites at 42.0%, with Copenhagen at 31.9% and the Asian handicap sitting at -0.25.
Crvena Zvezda lost their Conference League opener 3-2 at Lugano, with a late penalty deciding it.
facts.meaning: They are 24th of 36 with nothing from their opening game, so a home win is the target on Thursday night.

facts.fact: Copenhagen beat Braga 3-0 at home on matchday one, with xG 1.56 to 0.55.
facts.meaning: They arrive second in the 36-team table and with the better European result of the two sides.

facts.fact: Crvena Zvezda beat Mladost Lucani 5-1 at home on Sunday.
facts.meaning: Their domestic scoring form is the strongest argument behind the home price.

facts.fact: The goal line is 2.75, with Over priced at 50.9% — the market is split on whether this game reaches three goals.
facts.meaning: A near coin-flip on Over 2.75, so the expected total sits right around two and three-quarter goals.

facts.fact: Copenhagen drew 1-1 at home with Aarhus on Sunday, xG 2.01 to 0.94.
facts.meaning: They dropped points at home before travelling, and Midtjylland are now level with them at the top of the Superliga.

facts.fact: Novosti reports that Ivanić and Katić are back in the Crvena Zvezda squad for this match.
facts.meaning: Two more options for a side chasing its first points of the campaign.

facts.fact: Sportska centrala reports that Muhamed Čam will start for Crvena Zvezda after making the strongest impression among the substitutes at Lugano.
facts.meaning: One expected change to the XI, giving the home side a fresher option from the start.

sources.fact: Crvena zvezda lost 3-2 away at Lugano in their Conference League opener, with a late penalty deciding it.
Crvena zvezda host Copenhagen at the Rajko Mitić stadium on Thursday 22 October in the second round of the Conference League, still chasing their first points of the campaign.
Serbian outlet Sportska centrala reports that Crvena zvezda will line up slightly changed from the Lugano defeat, though no major changes are expected.
Serbian outlet Novosti reports that Ivanić and Katić have returned ahead of the Copenhagen match.
Marko Marin, now the club's technical director, recalled the 2019 penalty shootout against the Danes ahead of this fixture.
Midtjylland's derby win over Viborg drew them level on points with Copenhagen at the top of the Danish Superliga.
Parken Sport and Entertainment is exploring a full or partial sale of FC Copenhagen as part of a strategic review of its football business, Inside World Football reports.
Thapelo Maseko featured for Copenhagen in their Conference League match against Braga on 15 October.
